reviews.t: Great folks. This church arranged for me to donate a camper to a single mom and her five children. They were left homeless after hurricane Helene washed away there home. I drove down from Massachusetts with a camper that had bunks in it and a queen bed. The church made arrangements for me to drop it off. The church set it up for this family. Great organization doing wonderful things. God bless.

Living on the North Carolina coast, we understand firsthand the destruction hurricanes can bring. When Hurricane Helene struck Western North Carolina, I felt God calling me to leave home and go where the need was greatest. That calling led me to Gods Way Baptist Church, where I joined others in serving a community experiencing profound loss. Homes were destroyed, families were displaced, and many were left without basic necessities. Yet even in the midst of devastation, God’s presence was evident. The church became a place of refuge, prayer, and hope, and I witnessed faith in action as believers came together to serve one another. Through the hardship, God reminded us that we are called to be His hands and feet, bringing light, love, and compassion into the darkest moments.
God bless this church and congregation. Working hard supplying needs of local residents affected by Hurricane Helene. They need more volunteers to help.
Pastor Joel is always honest. He's kind and understanding, and he preaches the truth right out of the Bible.
Best place in the World! Everyone Loves God here and there is such a a sweet spirit of fellowship!
